AudioRef.description: A clip of the server, named by its content (cacheable for ever).
AudioRef.title: AudioRef

ClaimResult.description: Returned by POST /claims/verify and broadcast on the WebSocket (without trace).
ClaimResult.title: ClaimResult

CommentaryView.description: Payload of the WebSocket message `commentary`: one item for one profile.
CommentaryView.title: CommentaryView

Fact.description: A number that may be said out loud. Shared by the claim verifier, moments and Day 3.
Fact.title: Fact

HelloPayload.description:
`hello` / `resync`: the Day 2 state, plus the studio items rendered for the viewer's
profile when the studio is on.
HelloPayload.title: HelloPayload

LowerThirdView.description: Payload of `lower_third`: a lower-third in the profile's language.
LowerThirdView.title: LowerThirdView

MatchSnapshot.description: Live state for dashboards. Possession fields include the running possession.
MatchSnapshot.title: MatchSnapshot

MinuteWindow.description: Window on the football-minute axis, optionally restricted to one half.
MinuteWindow.title: MinuteWindow

Profile.description: Who is watching (Day 3 section 11): one per WebSocket connection.
Profile.title: Profile

RollingWindow.description: Window on the played-time axis (`match_ms`), for "the last N minutes".
RollingWindow.title: RollingWindow

SpeechCue.description: What to read aloud for one item and one voice; `audio` or `note`, never both.
SpeechCue.title: SpeechCue

SpeechSegment.description:
One part of a spoken script: the words read (numbers written as words) and their prosody,
shared by the SSML of the server and the browser's voice (docs/day5-design.md V4).
SpeechSegment.title: SpeechSegment
